audit.whatIsWrong: The Level-2 row told you to 'take the trade when Akali's Twilight Shroud is down' — she does not have Twilight Shroud at level 2 at all.
audit.why: Riot's kit: Twilight Shroud is her W and cannot be learned before level 3 in a normal skill order. Levels 1-2 are the only window where Malphite is not fighting an untargetable target, which is exactly what the content layer already says.
audit.corrected: phases[0].why and phases[1].why now name the real level-1-2 advantage and its expiry at 3.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Malphite levels 1-2, Akali level 3 (Twilight Shroud), level 6 (Perfect Execution), and her first AP item. Content spikes[] and the level chart agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twilight Shroud was described only as 'untargetable inside' with no cooldown, and Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution were never timed.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud is 20/19/18/17/16s and she cannot be selected by spells or attacks inside it, so Malphite's Seismic Shard and Unstoppable Force both have no target — the counterplay is a clock, not a mechanic. Shuriken Flip is 16s at rank 1 and is her only way in; Perfect Execution is 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries all three numbers and states why the untargetability, not the stealth, is the problem.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'Build MR (not armor)' Do had a body copy-pasted from the generic armour trade line, and referred to Akali as 'his'.
audit.why: Akali deals magic damage; Thunderclap's bonus armour and Ground Slam's armour ratio buy nothing defensively against her. The item answer is Negatron and Mercury's Treads first, which the content layer already states and the full layer contradicted.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[0].d to state the MR-first rule in the right gender.

edits.before: Q-poke wins level 1 and the move-speed steal compounds. Identify how Akali contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Akali only has Five Point Strike at 1 and no Twilight Shroud yet — walk up, Q-slow her off the cannon and bank the free chip.

edits.before: Passive shield resets between trades — space until it is back. Only take the trade when Akali's Twilight Shroud is down.
edits.after: She still has no Twilight Shroud, so 2 is your last clean window — Q-slow her off a cannon and land one W-empowered auto.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside. Fight when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Akali Twilight Shroud: 20s at rank 1 — inside it she cannot be selected by spells or attacks, so your Q and R have no target. - Shuriken Flip: 16s, her only way in. - Perfect Execution: 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Q Akali on his last-hits (speed steal in, slow out), E his attack speed if he answers, and reset behind the passive shield.
edits.after: Negatron and Mercury's Treads before any armour — Thunderclap and Ground Slam scale off a stat her magic damage ignores.

edits.before: That is Akali's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Every point of armour is dead weight against her — the whole kit is magic damage.

edits.before: Trading with your passive shield down — that shield IS your trade margin; without it you are paying full price.
edits.after: Inside Twilight Shroud she cannot be selected at all — you walk in, she re-appears behind you and resets the trade.
